admin_password_rule: At least 8 characters. Keep it safe – without this password you cannot open the settings.
admin_saved: Admin access saved. The new details apply at the next sign-in.
backup_desc: Saves settings, teams, music, effects and logo in a single ZIP file – for example on a USB stick.
backup_restored: Backup restored. Please sign in again.
broken_hint: Fix: in the data folder, replace config.json with a backup copy or delete it. After deleting it, ArenaFX starts with the setup, where you can restore a backup.
broken_text: The ArenaFX configuration is damaged and there is no readable backup copy. Your music is not affected.
config_recovered: The configuration was damaged. ArenaFX loaded the last valid backup copy – please check your most recent changes.
confirm_import_backup: All current settings, teams and media files will be replaced by the backup. Continue?
confirm_legacy_import: All current teams and media files will be replaced by the data of the old version. Your admin access is kept. Continue?
confirm_remove_team: Remove team “{name}”? Its music and effects are deleted when you save.
confirm_update: Update now? ArenaFX will close and restart.
data_folder_desc: Configuration and media files are stored here. The folder is kept when updating or uninstalling.
err_admin_password_short: The admin password must be at least 8 characters long.
err_admin_username: The user name must be 3 to 50 characters long.
err_app_name: Please enter a name with at most 80 characters.
err_backup_invalid: This is not a valid ArenaFX backup. Nothing was changed.
err_effect_label: Please enter a label with at most 40 characters.
err_effect_needs_file: Please choose a sound for this effect first.
err_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
err_hotkey_duplicate: The key “{detail}” is assigned more than once.
err_legacy_invalid: The configuration of the old version is damaged.
err_legacy_no_teams: No teams were found in the old version.
err_legacy_not_found: No old ArenaFX or Soundbox installation was found in this folder (media/config.json is missing).
err_login_failed: Sign-in failed. Please check the password.
err_login_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait {detail} seconds.
err_not_image: Please choose a PNG or JPG image.
err_setup_required: ArenaFX has not been set up yet.
err_team_name: Team names must not be empty and may have at most 60 characters.
err_team_name_duplicate: The team name “{detail}” is used more than once.
err_team_password_required: The new team “{detail}” needs a password.
err_team_password_short: Team passwords must be at least 4 characters long ({detail}).
err_team_required: There must be at least one team.
err_unsupported_format: format not supported (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC)
err_update_check: Update check failed. Is there an internet connection? ({detail})
err_update_install: The update could not be installed: {detail}
help_1: Music button: starts a random song at a random position and stops with a smooth fade-out. In warm-up mode, complete songs play one after another.
help_2: Announcement: lowers the music to 20 % so the speaker can be understood. Press again to raise it.
help_3: Effects: interrupt the music immediately and start without delay.
help_4: Keyboard shortcuts work while the ArenaFX window is active.
hotkeys_hint: Click a field and press the key you want. Delete or Backspace clears it.
import_desc: Restoring replaces all current data with the backup. Afterwards, sign in with the credentials from the backup.
import_locked: No password and therefore locked: {names}. Please set a password under “Teams”.
import_skipped: {count} files were skipped (not audio, too large or duplicate).
legacy_intro: Choose the folder of the previous ArenaFX or Soundbox installation (the folder containing “media”) or a backup folder of the old version. Music, effects, teams, logo and shortcuts are imported; the old files stay untouched.
legacy_locked_hint: Teams without a password are imported as locked. You can give them a password under “Teams” afterwards.
legacy_pick_first: Please choose the folder of the old installation first.
legacy_settings_desc: Imports teams, music, effects, logo and shortcuts from ArenaFX 1.x or the PHP Soundbox. Current data is replaced; your admin access is kept.
music_hint: Teams with their own music only play that. Teams without their own music play the general music.
team_music_hint: This music is only played for your team. Without your own music, the general music plays.
team_name_duplicate_hint: Name is used more than once
teams_hint: Each team signs in with its own password and has its own music and effects. Empty password field = password unchanged.
update_hint: Music, settings and teams are kept during the update. ArenaFX restarts automatically afterwards. Do not update during a game.
update_offline: Checking needs an internet connection. Without internet the soundbox keeps working normally.
update_restarting: Installing the update, ArenaFX will restart shortly …
